caption-generator.name: Caption Generator
caption-generator.longDescription: Upload a photo or short clip (we look at a key frame), or describe what you are posting in text or voice. You get ready-to-post captions, hashtags, and PPV wording. For video, you can ask for a simple arc in one go: hook, beats, on-screen text, and a closing call-to-action.

fantasy-writer.name: Fantasy Writer
fantasy-writer.longDescription: Generate DMs-ready fantasy from your cosmic calendar events, a scheduled content item, and/or a specific fan profile ÔÇö plus optional scenario text or voice.

content-ideas.name: Content and Caption
content-ideas.longDescription: Two modes in one place: get trending content ideas for your niche, or switch to the caption generatorÔÇöupload media (or describe with text/voice) for platform-ready captions, hashtags, and PPV copy.

photo-enhancer.name: Safe photo touch-up
photo-enhancer.description: AI blur, lighting, emoji ÔÇö text or voice
photo-enhancer.longDescription: Upload a photo and describe edits in text or voice; AI maps your request to safe blur, brightness, or emoji overlay (no beautify, inpaint, or video). Also available in Media & Vault with manual sliders.

ai-chatter.name: AI Chatter
ai-chatter.longDescription: Set up per-fan DM help on the AI Chatter page: drafts that match how you usually sound, a queue so you review before anything goes out, and an optional beta path to send automatically if you turn it on. Open it from AI Studio under Tools, or from your dashboardÔÇÖs AI Chatter section.

commenter.name: Commenter
commenter.description: Post comments: CRM signals, personas, safety
commenter.longDescription: Work from the Commenter page on your dashboard. It pulls comments on your posts, stories, and streams so you can see who said what and how heated or positive it feels. You get several suggested public replies in different tonesÔÇöplayful, warm, flirty, or straight professionalÔÇöplus one ÔÇ£bestÔÇØ blend to start from. Nothing posts for you: you copy what you like into OnlyFans. Odd or worrying threads can surface as Divine alerts so you do not miss them. If you want replies to lean a bit harder into upsell, you can turn that up in Divine Manager under automation settings for Commenter. Fan Atlas (smart list sync) lives on the same page when you want segments to stay honest.

housekeeping.name: Fan Atlas
housekeeping.description: Map fans into segments: spend, threads & intent
housekeeping.longDescription: Keeps your audience buckets honest: who spends, who chats often, who has gone quiet, and who looks like a freeloader versus a real prospect. You choose what each bucket means under Fans ÔåÆ Arrangements, then tie buckets to your OnlyFans lists and Fansly tags. The same Fan Atlas panel lives on the Commenter page. A background job refreshes those lists on a schedule so whales, steady spenders, and ÔÇ£needs attentionÔÇØ groups stay up to date without you micromanaging spreadsheets. Works best alongside Commenter so what fans do in public and in DMs lines up in one place.

gift-suggester.name: Gift Suggester
gift-suggester.longDescription: Suggest gifts using fan context, budget, and your saved wishlist. Add any number of product links on the Gift wishlist (Well-being, or AI Studio ÔåÆ gifts); we extract title, price, and details when a retailer allows it. Chatter and this runner use that context when a fan wants to send something. Open the runner from Divine Manager.

whale-whisperer.name: Whale Whisperer
whale-whisperer.longDescription: Opens AI Chatter in a VIP-only mode: same thread and ÔÇ£sounds like meÔÇØ context as regular chatter, but every line waits in a queue for you to send from MessagesÔÇönothing goes out on its own. Add your top fans from the Fans table or from the Chatter dashboard.

price-optimizer.name: Price Optimizer
price-optimizer.longDescription: Suggests angles for subscription price, PPV, and customs from your situation and goals. It does not appear as its own tile in the AI Studio gridÔÇöask Divine Manager in chat or voice to run the price optimizer for you.

dm-bundle-pricing.name: DM Bundle Pricing
dm-bundle-pricing.description: PPV / paid DM bundle price and copy
dm-bundle-pricing.longDescription: Suggests bundle prices and the short teaser text fans see, using your goal, who you are messaging, and what is in your vault. It is not a separate tile in AI StudioÔÇöask Divine Manager to recommend a DM bundle.

mass-dm-audience-suggester.name: Mass DM Audience Suggester
mass-dm-audience-suggester.description: Ranks the best fan cohort for a campaign goal
mass-dm-audience-suggester.longDescription: Power-user helper for Mass Campaigns. Reviews CRM + thread context and suggests who to target first for retention, conversion, or PPV goals.

mass-dm-fan-captions.name: Mass DM Fan Captions
mass-dm-fan-captions.description: Per-fan campaign copy from CRM + thread context
mass-dm-fan-captions.longDescription: Builds per-recipient DM copy for a selected campaign audience, using fan profile and thread signals for personalized variants.

mass-dm-ppv-pricing.name: Mass DM PPV Pricing
mass-dm-ppv-pricing.description: Per-fan PPV pricing from spend and campaign targets
mass-dm-ppv-pricing.longDescription: Suggests individualized PPV prices from fan spend, profile signals, and a campaign-level revenue target with a minimum floor.

credits-planner.name: Credits Planner
credits-planner.longDescription: Scans your fan count and recent revenue to build a premium-first monthly plan, with explicit separation between expiring included credits and non-expiring purchased credits.

viral-predictor.name: Viral Predictor
viral-predictor.longDescription: Gives a quick read on how strong a post might perform before you publish. It is not listed as its own card in AI StudioÔÇöask Divine Manager (chat or voice) to run a viral prediction.

churn-predictor.name: Churn Predictor
churn-predictor.description: Who's at risk ÔÇö Circe's Oracle for retention
churn-predictor.longDescription: Surfaces who is slipping away and what to try nextÔÇöexpiring subs, gone-quiet regulars, and similar patterns. The Retention area on your dashboard can send batch digests, Divine alerts, and saved reports. From AI Studio you can still run a one-fan deep dive with the same signals you already trust.

retention-tease.name: Subscriber retention tease
retention-tease.description: On-brand teasers for fans who are starting to slipÔÇötimed to your calendar.
retention-tease.longDescription: Jot whatÔÇÖs next on User retention by tease (Retention ÔåÆ calendar), run a single batch from the Churn hub, and get ready-to-use lines for feed, stories, and DMs. Credits match one churn-predictor background pass.

income-predictor.name: Income Predictor
income-predictor.longDescription: Combines partner-side revenue forecasting with what we already know from your synced numbers, how often you post, weekly and monthly rhythm, leak stress, and whether your goals are realisticÔÇöincluding gentler stepping-stone targets if a jump looks too steep. Open it from Analytics ÔåÆ Income Predictor on the dashboard.

leak-scanner.name: Leak Scanner
leak-scanner.longDescription: Configure background web scans under Protection ÔåÆ CirceÔÇÖs Aegis: same Serper + Grok pipeline as manual Protection scan, on your chosen cadence. Review every candidate before acting.

dmca-automator.name: DMCA Automator
dmca-automator.longDescription: From Aegis: optionally auto-create draft DMCA claims for high-severity leaks. Nothing is filed with hosts automatically ÔÇö open Protection to review, edit, and send each notice yourself.

voice-cloning.name: Voice Cloning
voice-cloning.description: Coming soon ÔÇö match your phrasing for DMs and scripts
voice-cloning.longDescription: **Not available yet.** We plan a dedicated runner to learn your phrasing and rhythm from samples (text or dictation), aligned with Divine Manager ÔåÆ Mimic Test for fan-reply style. Check back for a future Pro release.

competitor-analysis.name: Competitor Analysis
competitor-analysis.description: You vs peers in your band & one tier up
competitor-analysis.longDescription: For Pro: compares you to other creators in a similar-size band, then to the next band up, using anonymized cohort stats from CreatixÔÇönot anyoneÔÇÖs private revenue. You can add public @handles or short positioning notes so the run has real names to contrast. Optional web discovery and our shared tips library fill in context. We do not break into paywalled sites or steal private metrics. Not listed in AI Studio ÔåÆ ToolsÔÇöask Divine Manager to run competitor-analysis (or pin it on the home dashboard).

circe-protection-shield.name: Circe's Aegis
circe-protection-shield.longDescription: Open the Aegis hub under Protection: master shield toggle, Sentinel schedule (UTC), leak scan defaults, optional Hammer auto-drafts, and links to Mentions for reputation (separate from leak alerts).

venus-cupid.name: Cupid's Arrow
venus-cupid.description: Newest fans ÔÇö onboarding & early churn care
venus-cupid.longDescription: Lists your newest subscribers from CRM + live platform lists, then drafts warm introductions, first-touch care, and follow-ups. Tags saved CRM fans for Churn Predictor follow-through ÔÇö new subs churn easily until they feel seen.

standard-of-attraction.name: Standard of Attraction
standard-of-attraction.description: Pro rating of how commercially attractive your content is
standard-of-attraction.longDescription: Let Venus and Circe rate how commercially attractive your latest photos and videos areÔÇöthrough their eyesÔÇöbefore you post.

frame-studio.name: Frame Studio
frame-studio.description: In-browser video editing for creators. Trim, swap clips, and refine pacing without desktop software.
frame-studio.longDescription: Opens Media & Vault, where you can launch the Frame bridge, swap video, and use saved presets. If you self-host Frame, point the app at your deployment in environment settings so the button opens your editor. Divine can drop you straight on this hub when you ask.

frame-ai-assist.name: Frame AI Assist
frame-ai-assist.description: Editing and pacing copilot for Frame
frame-ai-assist.longDescription: Backend copilot for the Frame editor (messages in / out). Use it from Media & vault ÔåÆ video editor, or from a deployed Frame with your export tokenÔÇönot as a standalone dashboard ÔÇ£tool.ÔÇØ Divine can still invoke it by id when you ask.

ariadne-trace.name: Ariadne Trace
ariadne-trace.description: Uniquely mark each fan's exportÔÇötrace leaks back to who received the file
ariadne-trace.longDescription: Embeds a discreet marker in exported vault video so if a clip leaks you have a stronger clue which copy or recipient it came from. Use Media & Vault ÔåÆ Ariadne on files you already store; Frame export can use the same flow. Technical details live in the Ariadne spec in the repo docs if you need them.

ariadne-detect.name: Ariadne Detect
ariadne-detect.description: Decode marker from a suspected leak file
ariadne-detect.longDescription: Upload a suspected leak file; we look for an Ariadne marker and match it to your export history when possibleÔÇöuseful evidence before you draft a notice. Integrations can call the detect endpoint the same way the dashboard does.

brand-uniformity.name: Brand Uniformity
brand-uniformity.longDescription: Open the Brand Uniformity workspace from your dashboard when it is available.

mass-dm-composer.name: Mass DM Composer
mass-dm-composer.longDescription: Compose mass DM campaigns with AI assistance from the AI Studio runner.

venus-attraction.name: Venus attraction
venus-attraction.longDescription: This tool route is no longer available from AI Studio.
